description: Trigger (Request Campaign) a campaign for up to 100 leads, with optional campaign tokens. Write/side-effecting action.
embedding_description: Run a Marketo trigger campaign (Request Campaign API) against up to 100 specific leads by id, optionally overriding campaign tokens for that run — the verb that actually FIRES marketing automation (emails, list adds, scoring changes) defined inside the campaign. Requires the campaign_id from list_campaigns and lead_ids from get_leads.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Side-effecting action — confirm success and note the request_id; the actual marketing effects (emails sent, etc.) happen inside Marketo asynchronously.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Trigger a campaign for a batch of leads in the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing campaign_id/lead_ids, more than 100 lead_ids, or a malformed tokens entry. marketo.object_not_found: the campaign_id doesn't exist. marketo.validation_failed: the campaign isn't a trigger campaign, or a token name doesn't match one defined on it. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Execute Campaign — this permission is NOT checked by check_setup (unverifiable without actually triggering a campaign), so this may be the FIRST signal of the gap.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.object_not_found: confirm the campaign_id via list_campaigns. marketo.validation_failed: check the campaign type in Marketo and the token names against the campaign's defined tokens. marketo.permission_denied: add 'Execute Campaign' under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > <the API role> > Access API, then retry.
